beats.say: The Spark job ran for six hours. Yesterday it took one.
A senior engineer can say why it is slow. Not only how to write it.
beats.label: What they test
beats.head: Explain why it is slow

beats.say: Three things explain most slow jobs: shuffles, skew, and small files.
beats.label: Track 7 · Spark

check.prompt: When does Spark start to do the work?
check.why: Transformations only build a plan. An action, such as a write or a count, runs it.

beats.say: First: how does Spark run your code?
The driver makes the plan. The executors do the work, in many small tasks.
beats.label: Two roles
beats.head: Driver plans, executors work

beats.say: A transformation only adds to the plan. Nothing runs yet.
beats.label: Lazy
beats.head: Nothing runs yet

beats.say: The work starts at an action. For example, a write or a count.
beats.label: Action
beats.head: An action starts the work

beats.say: Second: the shuffle.
A join or a group by must bring the same keys together. So data moves between machines.
beats.label: What it is
beats.head: Same keys, same machine

beats.say: That move is the shuffle. It is the most costly step in most jobs.
beats.label: Why it matters
beats.head: The most costly step

beats.say: If one table is small, broadcast it. Then the big table does not shuffle.
beats.label: A fix
beats.head: Broadcast the small table

check.prompt: One task of a join runs for an hour, and the others take a minute. What is the cause?
check.why: One key holds most of the rows, so one partition gets most of the work.

beats.say: Third: one key has most of the rows.
That is skew. One task gets most of the data, and runs for hours.
beats.label: Skew
beats.head: One task does all the work

beats.say: In the Spark U I, you see it at once. One task is far slower than the rest.
beats.label: How to see it
beats.head: One slow task in the UI

beats.say: Turn on adaptive query execution. Or add a salt to split the hot key.
beats.label: Two fixes

beats.say: Last: thousands of small files.
Each file costs a listing and an open. Many small files make every reader slow.
beats.label: The problem
beats.head: Every file has a cost

beats.say: So write fewer, bigger files. And compact the table on a schedule.
beats.label: The fix
beats.head: Fewer, bigger files

beats.say: Quick recap of Spark.
Actions start the work. Shuffles cost the most. And skew shows as one slow task.
beats.label: Spark

beats.say: Now start the first lesson below.
